ref: #2 §4 collapseContexts, STD: "Empty contexts (= ResultList.SUPPRESS) are replaced by empty strings … Finally, all internal context changes are deleted" [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/43/c4cdfc334824478090739c04c4a249/content.htm] [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_crm70/helpdata/en/58/cd834014d26f1de10000000a1550b0/content.htm]
note: Empty contexts keep their place. o1 has no Line and o2's one Line has no Qty, so Qty in context Order is (empty) | (empty) | 5,6. collapseContexts replaces each empty context with "" ahead of o3's first value: All is "", "", 5. If empty contexts were dropped, All would be 5 alone; if the last value were kept, 6. To observe in PO, with obs-context-functions ctx-5 o4.
